summary: Cheniere Energy Partners, L.P. filed an 8-K to report entry into a Purchase Agreement to issue $1 billion of 5.350% Senior Notes due 2036 and $750 million of 6.050% Senior Notes due 2056, priced at 99.511% and 99.698% of par, respectively. The offering is for refinancing purposes, including redemption of $1.5 billion of outstanding 5.00% Senior Secured Notes due 2027. No change of control, acquisition, divestiture, or other special situation is present. This is a routine debt capital markets transaction, not a special situation.
